findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:480 has `choose_eq_smul [Field R] [CharZero R]`, while Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Sequence.lean:201 defines `Sequence.basis` generically over an `IsDomain`; no argument in lines 58–190 uses a property specific to `ℚ` beyond characteristic-zero field operations.
findings.fix: Parameterize the construction by `{K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]`, prove the basis and unique `ℤ`-coordinate theorem at that level, and obtain the `ℚ` use by specialization.
findings.issue: All declarations from `binomialPolynomial` through `mem_ringChooseSpan_X_iff_existsUnique` fix coefficients to `ℚ`, although the binomial-polynomial basis and its integral span are naturally defined in `K[X]` for `[Field K] [CharZero K]`.

summary: The entire construction is unnecessarily specialized to `ℚ`; its proofs and resulting integral basis work naturally over any characteristic-zero field.
